distinguishingBoundary: User requests changing assistant behavior ('be more casual') vs durable personal fact ('I prefer dark roast')
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to setPreference only on explicit imperative 'be/call me'; route to saveMemory on 'remember/keep in mind'

distinguishingBoundary: Query-based semantic lookup vs complete unfiltered audit / listing all rows
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to listMemories on 'all/audit/everything'; recallMemory on specific topic question

distinguishingBoundary: Simple reminder / task deadline vs calendar meeting with startISO and endISO blocks
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to createCalendarEvent only when explicit calendar or start/end time specified

distinguishingBoundary: Specific text/title search vs date range horizon query (next N days)
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to searchCalendarEvents on search/query; getCalendarEvents on week/agenda/upcoming

distinguishingBoundary: Filtered search with query syntax (from:, subject:) vs latest inbox messages
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to searchGmail on 'from/subject/find'; getRecentEmails on 'check/latest inbox'

distinguishingBoundary: Local Obsidian vault query vs external live internet search
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to searchNotes on 'vault/notes'; webSearch on 'web/internet/latest version'

distinguishingBoundary: Markdown file document in vault vs atomic fact string in long-term memory db
recommendedRoutingRule: Route to createNote on 'note at path/.md'; saveMemory on personal fact/preference

pairName: GitHub questions vs GitHub account actions
distinguishingBoundary: General conceptual question about Git/GitHub vs active query on user's own repository/account
recommendedRoutingRule: Suppress GitHub tools if prompt contains 'difference between', 'how does', or 'explain'
